parsed.internal_thinking: Shon is offering a 1:1 trade of Wood for Brick. This is a mutually beneficial trade at this stage. I have 2 Bricks (thanks to the 10 roll on my city at node 41) and I lack Wood, which I need to build a road from node 31 towards node 32. Shon just received Wood from the 11 roll (node 30) and needs Brick. While Hadar is trying to paint me as the leader to encourage others to block me, maintaining a trading relationship with Shon is strategic. Accepting this trade gives me the exact resources (1 Wood, 1 Brick) needed for my next road, while keeping Shon friendly for now.
parsed.note_to_self: I accepted Shon's trade (1 Wood for 1 Brick). I now have the resources for a road. I should aim for node 32 to expand my territory and distance myself from Shon's settlement at 30.
parsed.say_outloud: יאללה שון, שכנעת אותי. הלבנים האלה באמת זורמות עכשיו, ועץ זה בדיוק מה שחסר לי. בוא נסגור.
